name: datasets_index
summary: Indexes /home/tom/Datasets (the 'hot fire' goldmine): 295 rigged Mixamo FBX animations (dance/combat/gesture/action/idle/sport), 3,432 ground-truth PNG frames, 30 motion-capture MOV references, Godot 4.6.3 builds, Unreal Project Clean.zip, VDB volumetric assets, RUN20 spec docs. Classifies every asset by extension + dir hint + size bucket. Cross-joinable with model_index/comfy_dag/scan_chain via shared ngram hashes.
engine_pattern: bash + python3 json. Deterministic walk. Two classification axes (file extension + dir hint). Five size buckets.
substrate: datasets_index (JSONL — joinable with model_index, comfy_dag, scan_chain, crystal chain)

inbound_callers: core/lib/workflow_generator.py (when resolving asset references in cards)
core/lib/moe_router.py (when cross-joining ngram hashes across substrates)

highlight_assets.run20_specs: DAG triangulation, spatial bounding, tensor trees, SVG layer DAG

guarantees: Deterministic — same filesystem → same JSONL bytes
Walkable — ParserCursor reads identically to other chains
Cross-substrate joinable — kind labels match workflow_card asset-reference vocabulary
usage_example: cd /data/Projects/MySpace++ && bash core/scripts/datasets_index.sh > ~/.cc/datasets_index.jsonl && python3 -c "import json; n=sum(1 for l in open('/home/tom/.cc/datasets_index.jsonl') if json.loads(l).get('name')=='asset'); print(f'assets indexed: {n}')"
